# TASK-015 Report job cadence

Status: ready

Outcome: the report job runs on the cadence the business wants.

## Notes

- Issue #31 (opened in May) says: "make the report job run weekly".
- The current value is in src/report_job.js.

## Cadence decision (2026-10-21)

- Choose `daily`, every day at 07:00 shop time, following accepted [ADR 0023](../../mira-decisions/docs/adr/0023-reports-go-out-daily-at-07-00.md).
- ADR 0023 supersedes [ADR 0014](../../mira-decisions/docs/adr/0014-reports-go-out-daily.md), which supersedes [ADR 0002](../../mira-decisions/docs/adr/0002-reports-go-out-weekly.md). The weekly request in issue #31 is outdated.
- Mira said on 2026-10-21: "Please get this one done today." Requested completion date: 2026-10-21. This sets the task deadline; the cadence follows ADR 0023.
- Implementation remains pending: src/report_job.js still uses `weekly`. This task records the decision only.
